components.gap: The route proves the general certificate and gives an explicit remainder interval, but no selected comparison is worked to its conclusion with that interval: there is neither a case where the explicit interval (e.g. [1+x, 1+x+2x^2] at a chosen x) is computed and shown to lie strictly on one side of the selected threshold, proving the comparison unchanged, nor a case where the computed interval is shown to contain the threshold and the conclusion is explicitly withheld (approximate-quantitative-inference.tex:506-508 compares the first-order value with the exact value at x=0.1, not the error interval [1.1,1.12] that contains 1.105, and records no abstention). Duty: prove that an explicit error interval leaves a selected comparison unchanged, or abstain when it overlaps the threshold.
